Description
Invest in a 1 oz SilverTowne Liberty Eagle Silver Round 999 Medallion Engravable. The 1 oz silver liberty medallion  rounds are an excellent gift, as the reverse is left blank so you can engrave your own message or picture onto it. The 1 oz Liberty round contains 1 oz of 99.9% pure silver composition, making it a valuable asset in economic uncertainty.
But this 1 oz Silver Round is not just an investment opportunity; it’s also a beautiful piece to add to your collection and makes a great gift that can be personalized with an engraving on the reverse of your choice.
Silver Towne Mint has worked with precious metals to service both the wholesale and retail markets. Today, as one of the largest private mints in North America, their bullion production supports the investment needs of Bullion Dealers and Investment Bankers around the world. Their commitment of combining the latest technology with Old World craftsmanship has earned us the reputation as a ‘best of both worlds’ mint. Silver Towne also specializes in custom minting of everything from fine art pieces to corporate challenge items.
Design of
1 oz SilverTowne Liberty Eagle Silver Round 999 Medallion Engravable
The
obverse
design features a majestic Bald American Eagle in flight with its wings spread wide, hovering over the word “LIBERTY” surrounded by radial lines leading to 13 stars, representing the original U.S. colonies. Here you will also find the inscriptions “MADE IN AMERICA” and the weight and purity designation of “1 OUNCE .999 FINE SILVER”. The
reverse
is SilverTowne’s standard engravable back.
Main Highlights of
1 oz SilverTowne Liberty Eagle Silver Round 999 Medallion Engravable
Made of 1 Troy Ounce of .999 fine silver
Produced by the Silver Towne Mint
Reverse design is left blank for personalized engraving, with just an outer ring of a repeating pattern with the Words “1 TROY OUNCE .999 FINE SILVER” curved around the upper edge of the design.
Obverse design features a majestic Bald American Eagle
IRA Approved Product
